subject: Demonlord
text: Each Demonlord has approximately 60-70 HP and can cast Magic Mirror to reflect spells back at the caster.

evidence.quote:
They have about 60-70 HP each,  so it'll
take about 4 hits on each to kill them. Another really annoying thing they do
is "Magic Mirror", which basically bounces a spell you cast back on yourself.
